name: Carnage, Crimson Chaos and Can't Stay Away — a card returned from your graveyard is picked by its own words
notes: Memory: project_carnage_returned_card_picker_2026-10-16. 'Return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains "…"'. The fired trigger rewrote 'It' as plain 'target creature' (_abilityTargetBefore stopped at the type word) and the spell's pronoun got no restriction at all (_pronounAntecedentRestriction refused any phrase with 'card'), so both pickers listed Hill Giant (mana value 4), the opponent's Gray Ogre, and for the trigger Carnage itself. Now the returned card is read as 'target creature with mana value 3 or less you control', and a fired ability whose one target comes from your graveyard never lists its source. Carnage's trigger is fired once more at Grizzly Bears: the Bears gain both quoted abilities and Carnage neither.
